new: Headsets now ask for 90 Hz (Quest Browser runs at 72 unless asked). The Debug tab has a Refresh rate row, and the frame-rate read-out says 'fps of 90 Hz'.
The lobby is lighter: station cards no longer show a running clock, are redrawn one at a time, and the story left loaded does nothing while you are away from every circle.
The studio's edit mode no longer remakes labels, panels and picks every frame, and draws its tags and lines together: editing costs little more than viewing.
Trigger cubes can start things: an animation clip, a sound, a recorded path or a motion on an item, once, looping, held while inside, or stopped, as you walk in or out. Each person's own.

Update the room (Shared dialog, the menu's Circles tab, the update bar): two presses reload every device in the room in turn. Rooms no longer get lost after an update: the relay moves a room on to the new version.
A page in a room takes a new version by itself after 20 s (Not now holds it 5 minutes).
Stories: the design room draws about a third as much, background builds take about 1 ms a frame in a headset, and paused stories send nothing to the GPU.
Debug experiments, off by default: Foveation and Resolution rows on the Debug tab.
test: Lobby with only the stations visible: turn on the frame-rate read-out (double press B or Y). Does it say about 90 fps of 90 Hz now?
